title: font_merge_fallback silently drops the fallback glyphs when the fallback file reads but fails to rasterize
detail: A present-but-garbage fallback TTF (LoadFontData returns nil) hits the early return: the atlas builds ok=true without ⚠, app/harness run — the exact silent atlas the adjacent B1-residual branch refuses. Only the CI pin catches it.
recommended_fix: Make the fg==nil||ng==0 branch fail loudly too: return nil, 0 (matching the ferr branch), so any unusable fallback — missing or unrasterizable — refuses to load.

title: ci-local.sh gate-count comments drifted: header says 13, three other lines still say 10
evidence:
4:#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 13 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
6:#   tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 10 gates natively on macOS
31:  tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 10 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
33:  tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 10 gates natively on macOS
detail: The diff updated line 4 (10→13) but left line 6 and the usage() heredoc (lines 31, 33) saying 10 gates, while the GATES array now holds 13 entries. The script self-documents inconsistently.
recommended_fix: Update lines 6, 31, and 33 from "10 gates" to "13 gates" (usage() is user-facing output of -h).

title: PR body claims "11/11 gates green" but the shipped ci-local.sh runs 13 gates
evidence: - `tools/ci-local.sh` — **11/11 gates green** (incl. the golden harness, PP_DEBUG overlay builds, input parity, the W1 drift negative test).
detail: r3 added gates 12-13 (overlay smoke, font guard) after the PR body was written; the GATES array has 13 entries. The verification claim understates the suite reviewers will actually run.
recommended_fix: Re-run tools/ci-local.sh at the final head and update the PR body line to the actual gate count and result.

title: font_check.odin comment still claims draw_text_c "truncates every rune to a byte" — the behavior this diff removed
detail: The same diff rewrote draw_text_c/draw_text_font to copy raw UTF-8 bytes (view.odin: "for b in transmute([]u8)(txt)") and updated lint.sh gate 6's comment — this harness comment contradicts both and will mislead future readers.
recommended_fix: Reword to "game strings stay ASCII by lint gate 6; draw_row copies raw UTF-8 bytes like draw_text_font so the ⚠ rows reach the atlas".

title: build_probe_set re-implements the exported rnd.font_codepoints() instead of calling it
detail: The probe set duplicates the shipped atlas codepoint set (font_check already imports rnd). If font_codepoints grows, the probe silently desyncs from what the game actually rasterizes.
recommended_fix: Delete build_probe_set; use cps := rnd.font_codepoints() and pass cps[:] (and &cps[0]) to LoadFontEx.

title: overlay_pixels_check samples the framebuffer without the flip normalization, checking the vertically-mirrored band
detail: Every other rlsw readback in this codebase (overlay_check, gallery_shot, font_check) calls ImageFlipVertical after LoadImageFromScreen; this verb indexes raw rows, so its y-range actually screenscrapes rows 27..619, not the panel's 96..696. The smoke heuristic still passes, but it asserts on the wrong rect.
recommended_fix: Add rl.ImageFlipVertical(&img) after LoadImageFromScreen so the sampled rect is the actual NOC panel band.

title: Two font tests leak the merged glyph arrays (and the guard test its atlas images) while font_probe_warning frees them
evidence:
28:	defer rl.MemFree(glyphs) // test-side: the merged glyph block is raylib-owned (r3 note)
73:	_, _, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
76:	_, _, ok2 := font_atlas_build_from_file("assets/fonts/definitely-missing.ttf")
79:	_, _, ok3 := font_atlas_build_from_file("data/palette.json")
detail: font_guard_reports_missing_asset discards f, atlas, and glyphs unfreed; font_mono_tabular_digits frees the atlases but not the glyph arrays. Inconsistent with the r3-note pattern and the project's leak doctrine.
recommended_fix: Capture the returned Font/Image in all three guard calls and rl.MemFree(f.glyphs) + rl.UnloadImage(atlas) on the ok paths, mirroring font_probe_warning.
